happeningTypes.name: Provide feedback on declared judgment accuracy in a specified task
happeningTypes.description: Ask for judgment confidence/prediction and provide declared accuracy/calibration feedback in a specified task. Not generic praise, false confirming feedback or automatic skill/behavior benefit.
happeningTypes.constraints: Truthful declared feedback/material, consent/debriefing, privacy, contextual feasibility/legal/ethical assessment required. No practitioner recommendation or model eligibility.

happeningTypes.name: Forewarn of an upcoming persuasive appeal
happeningTypes.description: Disclose that a specified upcoming message attempts persuasion, with declared topic/timing. Not a refutation/inoculation package or automatic resistance.
happeningTypes.constraints: Truthful declared feedback/material, consent/debriefing, privacy, contextual feasibility/legal/ethical assessment required. No practitioner recommendation or model eligibility.

happeningTypes.name: Supply previously omitted opposing decision arguments
happeningTypes.description: Provide the previously unavailable countervailing arguments for a specified decision after initial information. Not falsehood correction, invented completeness or guaranteed sufficient understanding.
happeningTypes.constraints: Truthful declared feedback/material, consent/debriefing, privacy, contextual feasibility/legal/ethical assessment required. No practitioner recommendation or model eligibility.

assertions.scope: Specified perceptual/memory tasks with declared calibration feedback; distinguish eight-session and single-session schedules and initial bias.
assertions.measurement: Confidence level for a judgment, not Brier accuracy/sensitivity or reminder optimization.
assertions.timing: Protocol-specific timing; no universal persistence or transfer.
assertions.mechanism: Information/feedback may alter appraisal or strategy; exact canonical construct response requires independent measurement.
assertions.risk: Proxy/profile/time-scale and heterogeneous operation constraints; no truth/calibration/behavior benefit inferred, no practitioner/model eligibility.
assertions.rationale: Preserve positive/mixed/null findings at their actual contrasts. Exact construct, comparison and generalization are insufficient for a single signed effect.

findings.measurement: 1–4 confidence, Brier calibration and modeled metacognitive efficiency
findings.result: Calibration improved with confidence-level and efficiency changes; transfer to tested untrained stimuli/task, not all cognition.
findings.limitations: Mean confidence, calibration and modeled efficiency distinct. No causal mediation from early/late associations or universal lasting improvement.

findings.measurement: Predicted accuracy versus actual performance; reminder choices
findings.result: Feedback improved judgment accuracy from underconfidence, but no predicted reduction in reminder bias; confidence change direction depends on initial bias.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE exact eight-session schedule; same identity with scoped delivery differences. Sample demographic counts in text do not sum to116; no repaired estimate. Behavior nondetection not null confidence effect.

findings.measurement: Type-II sensitivity versus median confidence and first-order accuracy
findings.result: Noradrenergic blockade improved metacognitive sensitivity while median confidence and first-order performance showed no detected difference; dopamine blockade nondetection retained.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE feedback identity; demonstrates measurement distinction, not feedback-null evidence or clinical recommendation. No supported-zero equivalence.

findings.result: Involving/immediate topics favored defensive resistance; less-involving anticipated appeals could elicit preemptive agreement.
findings.limitations: Attitude outcome not independent motivation measure; coded involvement/context not exact causal moderator. No uniform warning benefit.

findings.timing: Immediate/moderate delay; later than two weeks
findings.result: Packages generally reduced attitude change; no detected increase in resistance as a function of threat/involvement; later decay reported.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE forewarning-only identity. Package/component inference prohibited; reduced attitude change not motivation or causal mediation.

findings.exposure: Bogus bolster/counterargue feedback after thought generation
findings.result: Perceived counterargument labels yielded certainty more sensitive to attacking argument quality; actual generated thought count was not the manipulated exposure.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE warning identity and direct resistance-motivation measure. No practitioner deception permission or causal mediation from modeled intentions.

findings.population: US Prolific convenience sample; hypothetical school water/merge decision
findings.context: US Prolific convenience sample; hypothetical school water/merge decision
findings.measurement: Five-item adequacy composite includes quantity, relevance, believability, importance and trust
findings.result: Partial-information participants reported comparable composite adequacy; authors report equivalence testing, but exact approved equivalence margin/measurement scope not reconciled here.
findings.limitations: Different initial-information contrast, not direct effect of supplemental article. Composite not pure PSY119. No SUPPORTED_NULL or zero encoded; source typographical statistical anomalies not corrected.

findings.design: Randomized routing to supplemental information after initial subset
findings.sample: Two subset groups split between survey and second article
findings.result: Recommendations moved toward full-information comparison and confidence decreased within supplemental groups; adequacy-like exploratory ratings not uniform increased sufficiency.
findings.limitations: Different measurement/time contrasts within same dataset; repeated before/after confidence not an independently isolated PSY119 effect; no claim all people revise beliefs.

findings.result: RISP predicts seeking/systematic processing but weaker heuristic explanation; reduced knowledge/norm model explains substantial variance.
findings.limitations: OUTSIDE exact supplemental-argument effect; prediction/SEM not causal sufficiency mechanism or mediation.
